_note: Default parameters. Scripts read this file first, then CLI args override. Change values here to set your preferred defaults.
_start_date_help: Start date (YYYYMMDD) for daily factor + market data.
_start_quarter_help: Start quarter (YYYYqN) for statement history. TTM and YoY need at least 9 quarters.
_pit_lag_days_help: Extra calendar days after a filing/announcement date before its data counts as known (0 = usable from the filing date itself).
_max_alphas_help: Default number of alphas per run.
_nan_threshold_help: Max NaN ratio before flagging expression.
